name: exposure-slider
title: Exposure Slider
description: Adjust photo brightness in EV and restore the original exposure.
useCases: A photographer adjusts portrait exposure and compares the preview with the original before saving.
In a photography lesson, a learner tries negative and positive exposure adjustments on one frame, then resets to zero.
task: Adjust photo brightness in EV and restore the original exposure.
behavior: Pass your photo URL in image. onChange reports exposure compensation between −2 and +2.
